newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Deutsche Bank Australia lifts 1996 pre-tax profit.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Bank Australia lifts 1996 pre-tax profit.

text.p: The Australian unit of giant German-based financial services group Deutsche Bank AG said on Thursday its pre-tax profit for calendar 1996 rose 21 percent to A$85 million.

The Deutsche Bank Australia group includes Deutsche Bank operations as well as investment bank Deutsche Morgan Grenfell which has subsumed the local investment banking arm formerly known as Bain and Co.
The bank said total assets increased by 34 percent to A$7 billion.
Since year end, the bank has bought the New South Wales public service funds manager Axiom for A$240 million from the New South Wales state government.
Axiom has about A$18 billion of funds under management.
German parent Deutsche Bank AG reported an operating profit for calendar 1996 of 5.8 billion marks with total assets of 886 billion marks.
